4. Pending such preparation of an environmental impact statement and reconsideration of the leases,
Westmoreland Resources is hereby enjoined from all future operations under the leases, except those taken pursuant to, and authorized by, the five-year mining plan approved on March 22, 1974, by the United States Geological Survey, covering an area of 770 acres, and except as stated in Paragraph 5 below;
5. Nothing in the terms of the foregoing injunction shall bar Westmoreland Resources from conducting such other operations on the leased lands as may be necessary or proper to: (1) conduct excavation operations within the 770-acre area, (2) conduct studies in connection with the preparation of further mining plans and environmental impact statements, or (3) take whatever steps may be necessary to meet the conditions of federal and state approval of mining under the existing mining plan which include, among other things, gathering information on water table levels and chemical characteristics of ground water, removing sediment from the settlement basin, and soil analysis.
Done and dated this 20th day of January, 1976.
United States District Judge
